title: Crispy Jamaican Celeriac Fritters
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and Jamaican flavors, these crispy fritters are made with celeriac and topped with a crunchy earthy crumble.
instructions: Grate the celeriac and mix with flour, eggs, and crispy jamaican spice mix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the celeriac mixture into the hot oil.
Cook the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and sprinkle with earthy oat crumble.
